name: Prince Bira
features: light brown skin, black hair, dark eyes, youthful open face, slight build, easy half-smile, pale blue cloth helmet and goggles
bio: Prince Birabongse Bhanudej of Siam, who raced under a nom de course as B. Bira in pale blue and yellow for his cousin Prince Chula's White Mouse Stable. Won the 1948 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort in a Maserati and the Richmond Trophy three times. A sculptor, a pilot and a four-time Olympic sailor for Thailand as well - and still the only Formula One driver his country has produced.
